items.quote: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
items.claim: The Israelite people complained to Moses about having no water to drink

items.quote: And he cried unto the LORD
items.claim: Moses called out to God in prayer

items.quote: and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet
items.claim: God showed Moses a tree that made water potable when placed in it

items.quote: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance
items.claim: God established laws and ordinances for the people at that location
God tested the people at that location

items.quote: If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
items.claim: God promises to withhold diseases from the obedient, having previously inflicted diseases upon Egypt, and identifies as a healer
